instructions.instruction: Pick up and stow the tissue in the left hand, then pick up the empty bottle with the right. Carry both to the bin, discard the bottle and move the right hand aside, then discard the tissue and stow both arms.
instructions.instruction_zh: 左手拿起纸巾并收拢，再用右手拿起空瓶；一起送到垃圾桶旁，先丢入空瓶并移开右手，再丢入纸巾，最后收回双臂。
